context: A chef and barista plan a winter event
purpose: Teach: イルミネーション/ろうそく/洋食/新緑/売れ筋/ロース/ファンクラブ/家族連れ

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、冬フェア、イルミネーションで店、飾ろか。
lines.en: Aoi-san, should we decorate the shop with some winter-fair lighting?
lines.style: Upbeat and enthusiastic, Kansai warmth. Quick tempo, natural cadence. Opening with friendly directness—not asking permission, inviting collaboration. Slight lean into the idea.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。卓上にろうそく、雰囲気作りに置きます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll set up some candles on the tables to build the atmosphere.
lines.style: Thoughtful and calm, speaking from quiet confidence in her own taste. Measured pace. Soft entry, no performance—just clear intent. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 洋食メニュー、限定で出そ。
lines.en: Let's put out a limited-run Western menu too.
lines.style: Practical, matter-of-fact. Quick decision-maker's tone. No flourish—just logic stacked neatly. Kansai directness underneath the simplicity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 春が来たら、新緑モチーフの飲み物、企画します。
lines.en: When spring comes, I'll design a fresh-green-themed drink special.
lines.style: Light and forward-looking. Gentle brightness without forced cheer. Natural pace, thinking aloud a little. Small lift at the end—ownership of the idea.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 人気の売れ筋、季節限定で更新しよ。
lines.en: Let's rotate our bestsellers with the seasons—keep things fresh.
lines.style: Knowing and assured, someone who's thought this through. Steady rhythm, no hesitation. Kansai warmth underneath the strategy. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ロースステーキ、メインに据えましょう。
lines.en: We should make loin steak the centerpiece of the Western menu.
lines.style: Engaged and positive. Light tempo, genuine interest in the detail. No pretense—just good sense expressed clearly. Small energy beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 地元バンドのファンクラブ、客層、広げてくれそうやな。
lines.en: The local band fan club will probably bring in a whole new crowd.
lines.style: Animated and observant. Warm Kansai enthusiasm—seeing the potential clearly. Quicker pace, slight lilt of excitement. The certainty of someone who knows his town.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 家族連れ向けに、子供メニューも充実させます。
lines.en: And I'll make sure the kids' menu is good too—we want to welcome families.
lines.style: Warm and inclusive, closing thought. Soft landing, genuine care underneath. No rush. Small smile at the end—someone thinking about the whole picture.
